exercises.name: Walking knee hugs
exercises.cue: Pull knee to chest, balance on standing leg for 1 second.

exercises.name: Walking quad pulls
exercises.cue: Tall posture, knee points down.

exercises.name: Leg swings — front/back
exercises.cue: Hold something for balance; relaxed, full range.

exercises.name: Leg swings — side/side
exercises.cue: Open the hip, don't twist the spine.

exercises.name: Walking lunges
exercises.cue: Front knee tracks over second toe; keep torso tall.

exercises.name: Glute bridges
exercises.cue: Squeeze glutes at the top; ribs down.

exercises.name: High knees
exercises.cue: Quick turnover; emphasize lift, not speed.

exercises.name: Strides (quality days only)
exercises.cue: Build to ~85% of 5K pace over 20 sec. 60 sec full recovery between. Skip on easy days.

pre_run.notes: Do this BEFORE every run. On easy/shakeout days, omit strides. On quality days (hill intervals, race-rhythm sessions), include the 3 x strides. During recovery weeks 1-2, do the mobility items only, gently.

exercises.name: Walking cooldown
exercises.cue: Walk until HR is below 110 bpm before stretching.

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.cue: Tuck pelvis under to feel the stretch in the front of the hip too.

exercises.name: Standing calf stretch (bent + straight knee)
exercises.cue: Two angles per side: knee straight (gastroc) and knee bent (soleus).

exercises.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
exercises.cue: Squeeze the back glute first, THEN lean forward.

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.cue: Square hips. If knee complains, lie back instead (figure-4 supine).

exercises.name: Foam roll quads, IT band, calves (optional)
exercises.cue: 60 seconds per area; pause and breathe on tender spots.

post_run.notes: Do within 15 minutes of finishing the run. Especially important after long runs and power-climb days — eccentric load + walking cooldown protects the quads.

exercises.name: Foot tripod + short-foot set
exercises.cue: Barefoot or socks. Set the arch before loading it.

exercises.name: Ankle dorsiflexion rocks
exercises.cue: Half-kneel, knee over toes, heel down. Descent-mobility priority.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: 2 s squeeze at top.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.cue: Slow and full range; the knee-gate warmup — no loaded knee work until these feel silent.

exercises.name: Bodyweight step-down (low box)
exercises.cue: Final knee check before any loaded step work.

pre_lower.notes: KNEE GATE lives here: loaded step-downs/step-ups only after the bodyweight versions are pain-free and the knee is warm.

exercises.name: Standing calf stretch (straight + bent knee)
exercises.cue: Both angles: gastroc and soleus.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
exercises.cue: Back glute on first, then lean.

exercises.name: Ankle dorsiflexion mobilization (wall)
exercises.cue: Knee to wall, heel down — bank the descent range while warm.

exercises.name: Toe yoga
exercises.cue: Big toe down, little toes up; then reverse.

exercises.name: Heel walks
exercises.cue: Toes up, walk on heels across the room.

exercises.name: Big-toe extension mobilization
exercises.cue: Kneel, toes tucked, gentle sit-back. Big-toe range for push-off.

exercises.name: Calf raise with eversion bias
exercises.cue: Rise with slight outward pressure — anti-pronation pattern.

exercises.cue: Heel leads, toe slightly down — glute med, not TFL.

exercises.name: Banded lateral walk
exercises.cue: Athletic stance, steps controlled both directions.

exercises.name: Single-leg balance reach

exercises.name: Band external rotation
exercises.cue: Elbow pinned to ribs. Left shoulder priority.

exercises.name: Scapular wall slides
exercises.cue: Forearms on wall, slide up without ribs flaring.

exercises.name: Tibialis raises
exercises.cue: Wall lean, toes up.

supplements.rationale: Anti-inflammatory support without blunting adaptation (unlike NSAIDs, which stay OFF around loading).

supplements.name: Magnesium glycinate
supplements.rationale: Sleep quality — recovery is the P1 multiplier.

supplements.timing: final 90 min of runs over 3 h; race day from ~hour 4.5
supplements.rationale: Race-proven pattern: 3 caffeine gels from mile 18, no issues.
